name: foreverworks-bitwarden
description: Give your assistant its own Bitwarden vault for logins, passwords, 2FA codes and passkeys.

BITWARDEN_CLIENT_ID_FILE.title: API key client id file
BITWARDEN_CLIENT_ID_FILE.description: Path of a file holding the account's API key client id.

BITWARDEN_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.title: API key client secret file
BITWARDEN_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.description: Path of a file holding the API key's client secret.

BITWARDEN_MASTER_PASSWORD_FILE.title: Master password file
BITWARDEN_MASTER_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Path of a file holding the master password that unlocks the vault.

BITWARDEN_SERVER.title: Bitwarden server
BITWARDEN_SERVER.description: A self-hosted or EU server, e.g. https://vault.bitwarden.eu. Leave empty for bitwarden.com.
